mainEntity.name: How do I see a live demo of Prompt?

acceptedAnswer.text: Book a demo on our website. Fill out a short form, pick a time that works for you, and you'll meet with a product expert for a walkthrough built around your practice and the questions you care about most.

mainEntity.name: How long does the demo take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Prompt demo normally runs ~45 minutes, though it can vary. It's built around your practice, so the exact length depends on how much you want to dig into specific workflows, pricing, and questions.

mainEntity.name: What happens during a Prompt demo?

acceptedAnswer.text: A demo is a real conversation, not a canned pitch. You'll meet with a product expert who knows the day-to-day realities of rehab therapy clinics, then walk through how practices like yours automate scheduling, billing, documentation, and patient communication. You'll also get into pricing, how quickly you can expect to see return on investment (ROI), and how Prompt compares to other systems, so you leave with the details you need to make a decision.
